result.summary: Found 3 issues related to layout and content truncation on this food delivery app home screen.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel shows a cut-off third item ('Smash Bros Bu...') with truncated restaurant name and image, which may look unintentional rather than clearly indicating scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partial cards are visually consistent as scroll affordances, or add a subtle gradient/arrow to indicate more items are available horizontally.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Smash Bros Bu...' is truncated abruptly without ellipsis styling that clearly indicates a scroll interaction.
issues.suggestion: Add proper ellipsis truncation and ensure the carousel visually communicates that more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The first two 'Green Bowl Poké' entries appear to be duplicate listings with identical images, delivery times, and prices, which may confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Verify whether duplicate listings are intended (e.g., different locations); if not, remove the duplicate or differentiate them clearly.
